title: QR Ph Reaches 55% Share of Payments in PH Businesses, Up 510% YoY – PayMongo Data
summary: PayMongo Group, a fintech company that provides a financial operating system for businesses, processed almost twice the transaction volume in the first half of 2026 compared to the same period last year – nearly 10 million completed transactions across a merchant base that grew 93% year-over-year.
